# Drawbridge

> Open-source firewall that stops AI agents from obeying hidden instructions in the web pages, emails, and files they read.

## Core Pages
- [Landing](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/): Overview, interactive Guard on/off demo, architecture, and SDK quick start.
- [Live Trace](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/trace): Step-by-step agent run timeline, taint origin lineage, and deterministic rule explanations.
- [Attack Lab](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/lab): 40 prompt-injection payloads across 5 categories and 60 benign calibration tasks.
- [Policy Editor](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/policy): Editable YAML policy with Zod validation and dry-run replay against past runs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/privacy): Local-only execution and storage notice.
- [Terms of Use](https://drawbridge-three.vercel.app/terms): MIT open-source license and threat model notice.
